herobrineultimate.ability.herobrine.desc: White eyes. A new presence. Transform your visible skin and display name.
herobrineultimate.ability.herobrine.deta: Live skin: first person arms and third person. Head and TAB display names use Herobrine. Equipment remains equipped.
herobrineultimate.ability.god.details: Ordinary damage is blocked while active. The kill command and damage that bypasses invulnerability remain effective.
herobrineultimate.ability.hunger.descrip: Keep hunger and saturation at their maximum.
herobrineultimate.ability.hunger.details: While active, the server maintains 20 food and 20 saturation. After disabling, hunger resumes changing normally from its current value.
herobrineultimate.ability.flight.details: Double-tap jump to fly, jump to rise and sneak to descend. Disabling flight restores your ordinary game mode abilities.
herobrineultimate.ability.lightning.desc: Call lightning at the block in your crosshair.
herobrineultimate.ability.lightning.deta: Use the assigned lightning shortcut to repeat a visual strike at a loaded target within 64 blocks. Destructive lightning also requires server permission and confirmation.
herobrineultimate.ability.combat.descrip: Adjust attack power and strike the target in your crosshair.
herobrineultimate.ability.combat.details: Special attacks select the first visible living target within 24 blocks. Allies are excluded. Player combat requires server permission and PvP.
herobrineultimate.ability.teleport.descr: Move to a safe location, record a waypoint and return.
herobrineultimate.ability.teleport.detai: Teleport near the aimed block within 64 blocks. Record one position and dimension; return if that destination is safe and loaded. Shortcuts can be changed with K.
herobrineultimate.ability.mob.descriptio: Summon companions and rally your bound creatures.
herobrineultimate.ability.mob.details: Wolves and cats are tamed; parrots are companions; iron golems guard nearby. Bound mobs follow while enabled. Maximum 16 registered companions.
herobrineultimate.ability.world.descript: Control time, weather and a small area of terrain.
herobrineultimate.ability.world.details: Time and weather affect the current dimension. Terrain editing processes a 3 × 3 × 3 area at the aimed block within 6 blocks; normal protection hooks remain active.
herobrineultimate.ability.invisibility.d: Apply vanilla invisibility and restore the prior state on disable.
Body visibility uses vanilla rules: armor and held items can remain visible. Collision is unchanged. Mob visibility follows vanilla invisibility and armor rules.
herobrineultimate.ability.motion.descrip: Tune movement, mining and attack speed independently.
herobrineultimate.ability.motion.details: Multipliers are limited by the server: movement 10×, mining 100×, attack speed 10×. Disabling restores the original attribute values.
herobrineultimate.ability.effects.descri: Enable transformation lightning, particles and the brief screen flash.
herobrineultimate.ability.effects.detail: Disable to suppress transformation effects. Panel glow is controlled independently by G in this panel. The white eyes remain emissive.
herobrineultimate.ui.toggle_hint: Your selection is stored by the server. The master shortcut suspends all abilities while preserving selections.
herobrineultimate.ui.backup: Keep a world backup before editing terrain.
herobrineultimate.ui.multiplier_hint: High multipliers can feel abrupt. Start low and adjust gradually.
herobrineultimate.ui.identity: Account name, UUID and authentication are preserved. Chat uses a server display name decoration where supported; signed message identity remains authentic.
herobrineultimate.ui.effect_cost: The panel uses flat geometry with a fixed number of borders. Transformation particles are emitted once rather than every frame.
herobrineultimate.ui.action_hint: The server must allow this action and the matching ability must be enabled.
herobrineultimate.ui.slider_hint: Drag, then release to apply. Focus and use arrow keys for fine adjustment.
herobrineultimate.ui.confirm.terrain: This edits up to 27 blocks around your crosshair. Keep a world backup. Continue?
herobrineultimate.ui.confirm.attack: Apply an instant attack to the first eligible target in your crosshair? Server PvP rules still apply.
herobrineultimate.ui.confirm.lightning: Request destructive lightning at your crosshair? The server must permit fire and damage. Keep a world backup.
herobrineultimate.message.waiting: Waiting for Herobrine Ultimate server state. Both sides need the mod.
herobrineultimate.message.denied: This server has enabled an optional restriction on Herobrine abilities.
herobrineultimate.ui.controls: Open key bindings. Resolve shortcut conflicts here.
